subject.title: [Bug] "Cannot convert undefined or null to object" in 2026.3.2 with google-vertex/gemini-3.1-pro-preview

question: Should this issue remain the canonical tracker until both the sanitizer and native Vertex ADC/gaxios paths are proven fixed, or should the auth-stack dependency path be split into a separate canonical issue now?
rationale: The active PR covers only the sanitizer slice, while the remaining dependency/auth-stack path touches provider auth and dependency policy where automation should not choose the long-term close or split shape alone.

options.title: Keep One Canonical Tracker
options.body: Keep this issue open until the sanitizer PR and native Vertex ADC/gaxios path both have live proof or an explicit maintainer proof override.

options.title: Split Auth-Stack Follow-Up
options.body: Create or nominate a focused canonical issue for the gaxios/node-fetch/domexception ADC failure, then let this issue close only after the sanitizer slice is merged and verified.

options.title: Override Sanitizer Proof Only
options.body: Accept source-level proof for the sanitizer PR while explicitly preserving the separate ADC reproduction elsewhere before closure.

recommendation.title: Keep One Canonical Tracker
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until the sanitizer PR and native Vertex ADC/gaxios path both have live proof or an explicit maintainer proof override.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice crosses SDK helper ownership, provider auth behavior, dependency policy, and canonical issue triage.
